morphology.pattern_note: 外来专名作为整词记忆，不按马来语词缀分析。历史上与拉丁人名 Marcus 的指小形式有关，但不构成现代马来语构词关系。索引键保留数据包的小写形式；正文人名应写 Marcellus。

senses.zh_definition: 马尔凯卢斯：源自拉丁语的男性人名，也可作为姓氏；具体所指须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Marcellus, a masculine personal name of Latin origin, also used as a surname.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki yang berasal daripada bahasa Latin dan juga digunakan sebagai nama keluarga; rujukannya bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 这里的 noun 指专有名词，不是已经核实的马来语普通名词。数据包不足以确定具体人物，也不能据此建立其他实体义项。人名词源参见 [Etymonline：Marcellus](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Marcellus)。现代读音依语言和本人习惯而异，因此不指定统一马来语 IPA。下列为示例性人名组合，不声称是高频固定搭配。

dual_scenarios.zh: Marcellus 先生将在明天的会议上汇报项目情况。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Marcellus will present the project report at tomorrow's meeting.

spoken_features: 句尾 ke 表示口语疑问

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Marcellus dah sampai kat pejabat ke? Aku nak jumpa dia kejap.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Marcellus sudah tiba di pejabat? Saya hendak berjumpa dengannya sebentar.
messages.zh: Marcellus 到办公室了吗？我想找他一下。
messages.en: Is Marcellus at the office yet? I need a quick word with him.

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia kat bilik mesyuarat. Pergilah jumpa dia.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah tiba dan berada di bilik mesyuarat. Pergilah berjumpa dengannya.
messages.zh: 到了，他在会议室。你去找他吧。
messages.en: Yes, he's in the meeting room. Go and see him.

etymology.historical_story: Marcellus began as a Latin diminutive of Marcus. Its history therefore belongs to personal naming rather than Malay word formation. Etymonline records that relationship directly. For a modern reader, the useful distinction is between the name's historical formation and its present function: someone called Marcellus has a personal name, not a descriptive Malay label. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Marcellus)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Marcellus 放进姓名牌里记：它回答“这人叫什么”，不是“这东西是什么意思”；正文首字母大写。
